title: Rav Acha bar Shisha
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Shabbat 60a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.60a.6) according to Dikdukei Soferim, interpreting a teaching before Rav Yosef; the text Hyman uses reads Rav Ada of Naresh.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Shabbat and [Heilprin’s entry for Rav Ada of Naresh](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=219&lang=en) name Ada as the one explaining the teaching before Rav Yosef. Hyman reports the alternate name Rav Acha bar Shisha from Dikdukei Soferim.
